features.name: up_link_cost
features.description: Uplink transmission cost to MEC server

features.name: mec_process_cost
features.description: MEC server processing cost = processing_data_size / mec_process_capable

features.name: down_link_cost
features.description: Downlink transmission cost from MEC server
